headline: Entero Healthcare acquires majority stake in Anand Chemiceutics
summary: Entero Healthcare has finalized the acquisition of a majority stake in Anand Chemiceutics. The company's stock rose 4% following the announcement. This move is part of Entero's strategy to strengthen its pharmaceutical distribution footprint. The integration is expected to enhance operational scale within the healthcare supply chain.
why_it_matters: Consolidation in pharma distribution may improve Entero's market reach and margins.
winners_losers: Entero Healthcare gains / competitors face consolidation pressure
